attempts_by_night.command: for d in 2026-10-15 2026-10-16 2026-10-17 2026-10-18 2026-10-19 2026-10-20 2026-10-21 2026-10-22 2026-10-23; do for ch in kartaview kartaview_streets; do ls logs/collect_*_${ch}_${d}.log | wc -l; done; grep -l 'HTTP 404, text/plain' logs/collect_*_kartaview*_${d}.log | wc -l; done
